title: The border can create new corners
hook: The border can create new corners.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.

doesNotKnow: Clip a polygon against a convex window using inside/outside edge transitions.

misconception: Clipping only removes existing outside vertices.
objective: Clip a polygon against a convex window using inside/outside edge transitions.

claims.text: Each clipping boundary transforms the polygon using inside-to-outside transitions. Crossing edges contribute intersections, and the output polygon becomes the input to the next boundary, preserving only the visible region.
